reference_cohort_info_part.model_build_note: This study used the pre-trained GAMLSS normative model from Bethlehem et al. (2022) Lifespan Brain Charts, trained on ~120,000 participants from 100 studies. The out-of-sample centile method was applied without re-training the model. Therefore, RCI-1 through RCI-7 extraction is not applicable as the reference cohort construction was not performed within this paper.

rci1_using_msad.detail: Pre-trained model from Bethlehem et al. (2022); reference cohort not constructed in this paper
rci1_using_msad.supporting_text: "The out-of-sample centile method used here enabled us to calculate centiles without the need to re-train the model on the ~120,000 subjects used for the original normative curves"
rci1_using_msad.location: GarciaSanMartin2025_sup1.docx.md: Supplementary Subjects and Methods / Centile-based normative model, L97
